title: Long-horizon coding agents with Claude in Microsoft Foundry
description:
AI-driven coding requires more than code generation, agents must know when work is complete and whether the result is actually correct. This session explores the architecture behind long-horizon coding agents with Claude in Microsoft Foundry, where planners break prompts into tasks, generators build solutions, and evaluators validate results in a real browser. Includes a live walkthrough from a single prompt to working software.

Seating for this session is first-come, first-served. Add it to your schedule to plan your day and arrive early to secure a spot.
